summary: END-TO-END functional test of the complete Board Fundraising Activation journey (Modules 2 → 5 + My Fundraising Board + Fundraising Portfolio) is PASSED. No real emails were sent (all send endpoints skipped; preview endpoints used to verify prepared content and secure links). No Stripe payments rerun. Backend pytest 4/4 PASS: Batch 4 e2e (Module 4 adoption guide + Module 5 toolkit — real Claude generations, ~180s) PASSED and Batch 5 e2e (My Fundraising Board + Fundraising Portfolio — real Claude portfolio generation) PASSED, plus 2 configuration-inspection tests for activation accountability + nurture PASSED. Frontend smoke via Playwright: /activate, /activate-with-rooney, /activate-your-board-yourself, /board-activation-proposal all HTTP 200 with correct headlines; /activation-start-here, /app/activation/self-guided/module/1, /module/4, /module/5, and /my-fundraising-board all render with the correct layout for the seeded activation-tester. My Fundraising Board dashboard shows exactly '2 Board Members Participating · 1 Responsibility Agreed · 1 Follow-Up Needed · 1 Portfolios Approved · 0 Portfolios Sent', both members with their statuses, the FINAL ADOPTED FUNDRAISING STRATEGY PLAN + APPROVED BOARD FUNDRAISING EXECUTION TOOLKIT buttons, and Alice's card with the exact agreed responsibility text + REGENERATE/VIEW ONLINE/EDIT/PDF/PREPARE PORTFOLIO EMAIL controls (no direct SEND fired). PASSED per area — Public Activation pages: PASSED. Module 2 planning: PASSED (verified in iter43; re-exercised via my-board data integrity checks). Module 3 strategy + board review: PASSED (verified in iter44 and preserved through this run — strategy.status='Ready for Board Review' review_version=2, Alice REVIEWED under v1). Module 4 adoption: PASSED (guide generated with all 13 headings in strict order, org-specific, no invented bylaws/quorum/legal, Alice-attributed feedback in sections 6 and 9, guide edit → save → approve → PDF works, conclusion persists, all three plan_status values verified — Further Review Needed BLOCKS module 5 with 409 on toolkit/generate and gate_open=false, Adopted as Presented copies reviewed text and finalizes, Adopted With Changes allows edit + finalize with adopted_text preserved separately from reviewed_text). Module 5 toolkit: PASSED (toolkit generated, contains BOARD FUNDRAISING EXECUTION TOOLKIT + CALL SCRIPTS with 'When to use / Opening / Why I am calling / Close' labels, no invented donors/dollar amounts, edit → save → approve → PDF works). My Fundraising Board: PASSED. Fundraising Portfolio: PASSED (Alice's portfolio uses her exact agreed 'corporate sponsorship' responsibility, includes 'Activation Test Nonprofit', mentions Alice but NOT Carol, no AI mention, no invented $ amounts/donors, edit → save → approve → PDF works; email-preview returns to_email=alice, subject 'Your Fundraising Portfolio | Activation Test Nonprofit', body contains [VIEW MY FUNDRAISING PORTFOLIO], form_link autoinserted /fundraising-portfolio/<token>; public GET /api/fundraising-portfolio/<token> serves WITHOUT auth returning member_name, organization_name, issued_by, and text including the founder edit marker; public PDF works; invalid token 404). Portfolio generation BLOCKED for Carol (Follow-Up Needed) with 409. Portfolio email-preview BLOCKED for Carol with 409. Unauthenticated access to /api/activation/my-board and portfolio/generate returns 401/403. Secure external links (planning-form, strategy-review, fundraising-portfolio) all work without login as verified across iterations 43/44/45. Accountability configuration: PASSED — activation_accountability.py enrolls ONLY PURCHASE_SOURCE='direct_diy_board_activation_497' (DWM $2,497 project excluded — string 'direct_board_activation_project_2497' does not appear in the file), imports from shared accountability_service (CHECKIN_DAYS, send_rooney_email, utc_now, within_send_window, origin_url), activation_stage is progress-aware using course_progress + planning form + participants + strategy + reviews + adoption + toolkit + agreed responsibilities + portfolios_approved, STAGE_EMAILS covers all 9 stages (get_started, start_planning, board_input, build_strategy, board_review, facilitate_adoption, equip_board, complete_board, completed). Nurture configuration: PASSED — ACTIVATION_LEAD_NURTURE_ENABLED="false" in /app/backend/.env (verified), enabled_nurture_sources() does NOT contain 'fundraising_activation', NURTURE_TEMPLATES['fundraising_activation'] has EXACTLY 3 templates in rotation order (1: /about-rooney, 2: /activate-your-board-yourself with $497 CTA, 3: /board-activation-proposal with $2,497 CTA), run_weekly_nurture uses LEAD_NURTURE_DAY default Tuesday and LEAD_NURTURE_TIMEZONE env, purchase-stop stop_recruitment_nurture_for_purchase covers BOTH activation purchase sources (ACTIVATION_PURCHASE_SOURCES = {'direct_diy_board_activation_497','direct_board_activation_project_2497'}), board_transformation is NOT in NURTURE_TEMPLATES so sync_lead_nurture returns early for it (verified via 'if source not in NURTURE_TEMPLATES: return' guard). The complete Activation journey is FUNCTIONAL end-to-end for a real customer. Non-blocking: founder-notification emails to @example.com fail Resend validation but are correctly wrapped in try/except throughout — explicitly permitted by spec (test customer email is @example.com).

minor.issue: Response payload (fp_row) does not expose fp_share_token, so the founder UI can only obtain the secure portfolio link via the email-preview endpoint (which returns form_link). This is by design — the frontend uses the email-preview form_link — but it does mean 'give me the link without preparing an email' has no dedicated endpoint. Non-blocking; the flow works because the UI pulls the link from email-preview.

critical_code_review_comments: activation_planning_routes.generate_fundraising_portfolio correctly enforces both gates before generating: (1) module5_ready(adoption) — requires adoption plan_status in {'Adopted as Presented','Adopted With Changes'} and finalized=True — and (2) participant.responsibility_status == 'Responsibility Agreed' with a non-empty agreed_responsibility. Verified 409 on Carol (Follow-Up Needed). This is the correct behavior to prevent inventing a responsibility.

The portfolio LLM context includes an 'EXACT AGREED FUNDRAISING RESPONSIBILITY (highest authority)' block plus the final adopted strategy + THIS MEMBER'S OWN planning response and review (not another member's). Content assertions confirm Alice's portfolio references her actual corporate-sponsorship agreement and does not mention Carol.

Public /api/fundraising-portfolio/{token} 404s cleanly on invalid tokens and only serves records with fp_status in {'Approved','SENT'} and non-empty fp_approved_text. No _id leakage (projection {'_id':0}).

activation_accountability.py: line 105 correctly skips @example.com purchasers so we can safely leave the test customer's engagement disabled; PURCHASE_SOURCE constant is only DIY (DWM excluded); activation_stage is fully progress-aware.

marketing_service.NURTURE_TEMPLATES['fundraising_activation'] now has exactly 3 items with the correct rotation targets and CTA prices ($497 / $2,497). The previous duplicate key mentioned in the handoff is not present. enabled_nurture_sources() correctly returns empty for activation because ACTIVATION_LEAD_NURTURE_ENABLED='false'. sync_lead_nurture early-returns for sources not in NURTURE_TEMPLATES, so board_transformation leads are not auto-enrolled.
activation_accountability.activation_stage: no unused 'reviews' variable — the 'reviewed' count is used on line 38. Confirmed the handoff cleanup is intact.

Portfolio email-preview endpoint auto-inserts the /fundraising-portfolio/{token} link in form_link so the frontend can display + copy it — good separation between prepared-content viewing and actual send.

One small transparency issue (already reported as minor): fp_row does not include fp_share_token in GET /activation/members/{id}/portfolio. If E1 wants the UI to display the share link outside the email-preview modal, this field could be exposed. Non-blocking.
